summary: Tested the two new features (dismiss announcements + copy/share link) plus regression flows. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (added 4 new tests for /messages: newest-first ordering, message id present, public read exposes messages without passcode leak, 401 wrong passcode, 400 empty text). Frontend control panel: COPY LINK toggles to 'COPIED!' on tap then reverts to 'COPY LINK' after 2s, SHARE button still present, SEND ANNOUNCEMENT works and message appears in control list immediately, ADVANCE moves Race 1→2 and PREVIOUS reverts back to Race 1. Frontend live view (/live?code=Q928K3): announcements render with dismiss (X) buttons (testID dismiss-announcement-{id}), tapping X removes that specific announcement from view, persists to localStorage under key dismissed_Q928K3 as JSON array of ids, and remains dismissed after full page reload. Regression flow (announcement broadcast → poll within ~3s) verified end-to-end across two browser contexts.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still warns 'SafeAreaView has been deprecated...use react-native-safe-area-context'. Used in /app/frontend/app/live.tsx:7 and /app/frontend/app/control.tsx:7. Pre-existing, non-blocking, carried over from iteration 1.

action_items: Optional: migrate SafeAreaView imports to 'react-native-safe-area-context' across live.tsx and control.tsx to silence the deprecation warning (pre-existing).
critical_code_review_comments: live.tsx dismiss logic correctly filters meet.messages by dismissed[] before slicing top 3 and persists via storage.setItem(dismissKey, ...) — no race condition since setDismissed and storage.setItem run together.

control.tsx onCopyLink uses expo-clipboard's Clipboard.setStringAsync and toggles `copied` for 2s via setTimeout — clean implementation; shareLink uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (no hardcoded URL).
Backend POST /messages prepends newest message and trims to 20; passcode stripped via public_meet() on GET /meets/{code} — verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (copy-link, share visible, send announcement, advance, previous, dismiss + persistence + reload)

seed_data_creation: Used existing meet Q928K3 (id d7ff6a59-12a0-49e8-b154-f25409ebfdf6, passcode swim123). Added one TEST_E2E_<ts> announcement during testing. New pytest also creates TEST_-prefixed meets that can be swept.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_meets.py -v`. All 22 pass. Live view dismiss persistence uses localStorage key `dismissed_{code}` storing a JSON array of message ids. Copy button text states: 'COPY LINK' → 'COPIED!' for 2s → 'COPY LINK'. Meet Q928K3 is the working sample meet; create a fresh meet if its message count grows unwieldy.
